snippet.description:
How do you actually write a good PSIR answer?

In this test discussion, Chandan Sir breaks down questions from Western Political Thought and explains what UPSC really expects in an answer. From Mill and Plato to Machiavelli, Hobbes, Locke, Gramsci and Arendt, the focus is not on filling pages with theory, but on understanding the question, building a clear structure and using thinkers where they actually add value.

A practical discussion on writing better PSIR answers without turning them into model-answer copies.
